name: ui_dump
description: Dump the UI element hierarchy from a connected device. Returns JSON with all visible elements including text, resource-id, class, bounds, center coordinates, and clickable state. Use this to discover what's on screen before interacting with UI elements.

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)
